subject: Senior stakeholder timeboxing for architecture deep dive
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Senior stakeholder timeboxing for architecture deep dive

Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive next week. Clearsky’s product and platform teams plus your leadership sponsor joining will be hugely helpful to lock down the integration checkpoints and rollout constraints.

Quick ask: can we reserve a 30–45 minute block where your exec sponsor (CTO/Head of Platform) can hear the architecture summary and ask clarifying questions? We want that sponsor window near the start of the session so we can align on success criteria before the team breaks into the detailed tracks.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-10-20, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed 2026-10-21, 9:30–10:15am
- Thu 2026-10-22, 1:00–1:45pm

If none of these work, tell me one 30-min window that your sponsor can guarantee and we’ll lock around it. Attaching a draft agenda and attendee matrix.

Agenda (attached): 10 min executive overview, 15 min technical architecture, 10 min Q&A/risks, 5 min next steps.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Amelia Novak <amelia@clearsky.ai>

Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior stakeholder timeboxing for architecture deep dive

Sean —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick reality check on the sponsor availability: our CTO, Priya Rao, has a very limited calendar this week and can only commit to 20–30 minutes on either Tue afternoon or Thu early afternoon (Pacific). She’s traveling Wed.

From our side the best guaranteed windows are:
- Tue 2026-10-20, 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Thu 2026-10-22, 12:30–1:00pm PT (she can extend to 1:15 if required)

If you need the sponsor slot earlier in the day for Redwood’s sequencing, we can try to make Tue 10–10:30am work but it would be conditional on a flight change and I can’t confirm until Monday EOD.

Also: can you prep a 1-slide TL;DR for the exec session (goals + risk icons) so Priya has something compact to scan beforehand? We’ll circulate the pre-read to the exec attendees.

—Amelia
Amelia Novak
Head of Product Partnerships, Clearsky AI

Amelia / Sean —

We can accommodate a 30-minute sponsor window on either Tue 2:00–2:30pm PT or Thu 12:30–1:00pm PT. Sean: if Thu is shorter for Priya, we should pick Tue to give a small buffer for Q&A.

I’ve attached the most recent agenda (minor edits) and a proposed attendee list so we can limit the exec view to the right stakeholders. Please review and flag anyone to remove from the sponsor portion — we usually keep that portion to senior product, platform, and the lead architect.

If Tue 2pm is a go, we’ll mark the slot as “Sponsor review (exec only) — 30m” in the calendar and push the team deep-dive to follow immediately after.

Thanks,
Monica

Director, Solutions Engineering
